title: T (batch 42) on the helper box: the pointer directions in the varied scenes and the natural passages, qwen3.5-9b
command: BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-9b BJ_DEVICE_MAP= uv run python scripts/x0b_generalize.py run --name qwen35_9b_x0b_v2_ptr --set x0b_v2 --no-curve --pointer; s1=$?; BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-9b BJ_DEVICE_MAP= uv run python scripts/x5_natural.py run --name qwen35_9b_x5_natural_ptr --pointer; s2=$?; test $s1 -eq 0 -a $s2 -eq 0
question: Do the pointer directions, fit on the simple scenes at the layer fixed in advance and not refit, cost the lookup beyond their random part in the varied scenes (every format and level) and in the natural passages?
why_it_matters: The pointer route is shown on simple scenes; T asks whether the same directions carry the lookup's route where the scenes vary in format and level, and in natural text (Dan).

hypotheses.H-batch42: Dan's batch 42 (Q42.1-Q42.3), predictions/2026-10-26_dan.md, committed before any result is opened

decision_rule: Fixed in advance (batch 42, ~11:55): the arms without the pointer directions and without a random part of their share (per scene); the lookup's and the recall's extra loss (switches lost minus the random part's), pooled and per format (prose / json / table) in the varied scenes; in the natural passages on the passages where the fact comes first and the lookup switches (n reported). Q42.1 pooled lookup >= 0.20; Q42.2 json and tables >= 0.15; Q42.3 natural passages >= 0.15 with lower CI > 0; each counted over the 9B, the 27B, the 122B and Muse. Gates as in each script (X0b per cell; natural passages 0.80, not lowered). Cluster bootstrap over bridge entities, 10,000 resamples, seed 0.
controls: a random part at the pointer directions' share, per scene
both readers on the identical patch
n: the eligible scenes of each set (X0b: at most 40 per cell; the natural passages that pass the gate)
notes: Results stay closed until Dan's batch-42 answers are committed. The 9B's natural passages missed the 0.80 gate before (lookup 0.78): not tested if it misses again (no rerun at 0.75 unless Dan asks).

title: Batch 44 on helper: A, the writes (s = 1 primary; 2, 4 and random), qwen3.5-9b
command: BJ_TARGET=qwen3.5-9b BJ_DEVICE_MAP= uv run python scripts/x8_write.py run --name qwen35_9b_x8_write
question: Do the pointer directions hold an address the lookup reads: does writing one generic address mu_k - mu_j at the bridge word send the lookup to locker k (against a random direction of the same norm and the third locker), and do order, sentence index or distance set the slot code?
why_it_matters: So far the pointer directions are necessary, and sufficient when taken from each scene's own change; neither shows an address the model reads by (Dan).

hypotheses.H-batch44: Dan's batch 44 (Q44.1-Q44.4), predictions/2026-10-26_dan.md, committed before any result is opened

decision_rule: Fixed in advance (batch 44): Q44.1 at s = 1 the target share minus the random direction's >= 0.15 with lower CI > 0; Q44.2 among writes that move the lookup to another locker target / (target + third) >= 0.80, a model counting only with >= 30 such writes, fewer than two counting = can't tell; Q44.3 target minus random >= 0.10 in each of the 6 (j, k) pairs; Q44.4 (the 9B, B) order / sentence index / distance by which variant shifts (mean beta >= 0.5, lower CI > 0); each over the 9B, the 27B, the 122B and Muse. Gate and eligibility as the routes test (the 122B at 0.75, after the data). Cluster bootstrap over bridge items, 10,000 resamples, seed 0.
controls: a random direction of the same norm per write (seed 4401)
the recall on the same write (lookup-specific or not)
B: the unchanged prompt B0 (paired shift)
n: the routes test's eligible C2 scenes (up to 300), 2 writes each
notes: Results stay closed until Dan's batch-44 answers are committed. Cut order if late (Dan): B on the 122B; then all of B; then the halfway writes; then A's s = 2 / 4; A at s = 1 never cut.
